intent.text: Mars sunset base, readable exteriors, warm lit interiors

then.value: Power restored. Airlocks unlocked. Enter the Command Centre (north-west) and press E at the blue console

then.text: POWER RESTORED - airlocks unlocked. Head to the Command Centre.

then.value: Distress call sent. Help is on the way.

then.text: Distress call sent - Kepler Base is saved!
No power - switch on all three solar arrays first.
Rover: WASD to drive, Q to get off

state.objective: Reach the 3 solar arrays east of base and press E at each red switch

hab-dome.description: Faceted pressurised dome (glass or opaque panelled) with ribs, plinth, knee wall and up to three doorways at given angles. Walkable floor and wall colliders.

glass-corridor.description: Glass-roofed pressurised corridor along X with low walls, ribs, floor grating and colliders.

solar-array.description: Field of tilted photovoltaic panel rows on posts over a concrete pad, with row colliders.

mars-lander.description: Crewed landing craft on four legs with ladder, nozzles, window band. Underside is walkable-under.

mars-crater.description: Impact crater: flat floor, raised eroded rim and ejecta slope blending to ground at y=0. Trimesh collider.

ice-plant.description: Water-ice processing plant: main building, storage tanks, derrick drill rig, piping and ice stockpile.

fuel-tanks.description: Propellant farm: two horizontal bullet tanks on cradles, one spherical tank on legs, manifold pipes, hazard bands.

comms-mast.description: Tall triangular lattice comms mast with dishes, antennas, platforms and a red beacon; guyed base.

wind-turbine.description: Modern three-bladed wind turbine with a tapered white tower, streamlined nacelle, contrasting hub details, access door, and long swept blades.

kepler-dome.description: Kepler Base habitat dome: round concrete floor with inlay, segmented wall ring with door gaps and lintels, tall ribbed cap (opaque or glass, apex about 0.4R+5.3 m so ceiling rods reach it). Every shell material is doubleSided. Door angles are world degrees atan2(dz,dx), x east, z south.

kepler-corridor.description: Kepler Base corridor/airlock tube along local X (length), flat-roofed with ribs, a warm light strip and a floor plate. All materials doubleSided. Floor top at y=0.12, clear height 2.4.

mars-regolith.description: Visual regolith overlay for the base plateau: gently rippled heightfield with vertex-coloured soil variation plus clusters of cobbles, skipping the base footprint, walkways and pad. Rim drops to -1 m so the entity must sit at y=-1+offset. Decor only (no collider).

kepler-dome-lit.description: Habitat dome with every surface double-sided: floor disc, 2.5-degree wall ring with door gaps and lintels (a wider bay opening), accent band, glazed or panelled flattened dome with ribs. Explicit colliders so doorways stay walkable.
